<span id="c750beba"></span>
# Problem description

The length of the `Prefix` field in the lifecycle rule configuration is invalid.

<span id="4fe7465e"></span>
# Root cause

The length of the `Prefix` configured in the lifecycle rule exceeds 1024; it must be within 1024.

<span id="104cff06"></span>
# Example

```JSON
{
    "Rules": [{
      "ID": "id",
      "Prefix": "",
      "Status": "Enabled",
      "Expiration": { "Days": 120 },
      "NoncurrentVersionExpiration": { "NoncurrentDays": 120 },
      "AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload": { "DaysAfterInitiation": 10 },
      "Transitions": [
        {
          "StorageClass": "IA",
          "Days": 30
        },
        {
          "StorageClass": "COLD_ARCHIVE",
          "Days": 60
        }
      ],
      "NoncurrentVersionTransitions": [
        {
          "StorageClass": "IA",
          "NoncurrentDays": 30
        },
        {
          "StorageClass": "COLD_ARCHIVE",
          "NoncurrentDays": 60
        }
      ]
    }]
}
```


<span id="9c931fb1"></span>
# Solution

The length of the `Prefix` configured in the lifecycle rule must be within 1024.
